system.description:
The dragon-kin warriors of Deteron and the hardest of the Dul Khagul clans: fury carried on a hide that won't break.

  • Reshapes: Primeval Will (it gives more temporary HP).
  • Dragon Line: at 1st level choose a line: fire (red, gold, brass), cold (white, silver), lightning (blue, bronze), poison (green) or acid (black, copper). A Dragonborn takes its own draconic type. The kit's damage type is your line's.
  • Dragon-kin Resilience: Advantage on saves against your line's damage type. Primeval Will gives temporary HP equal to three times your Barbarian level.
    • 9th level: while raging, you have Resistance 5 to your line's damage type (Resistance 10 for a Dragonborn).
  • Dragon Culture: Advantage on checks involving dragon-kin customs, and on identifying dragon-made or dwarf-made arms and armour.
